label: final copy step of length-3 sequences
explanation: Active only in the copy phase, almost entirely at the last output step (to_go == 0) of L=3 sequences (t=5: input is the 2nd original token, output is the 3rd). Fires on ~86% of such steps and these hold ~89% of activation mass. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or at first-occurrence inputs. The largest activations come when the input (2nd original token) is v, m, r or w (e.g. q v o <DEL> q [v]). The remaining ~11% of mass is weak firing at the last or second-to-last copy step of longer sequences (mostly L=4 and L=6), mainly when the input is l, v or r. Low-quartile activations are mostly these longer-sequence cases.

issues: I could not refute the main claims. On test the predicate scores precision 0.866, recall 0.665, F1 0.752 and mass recall 0.884, matching the report. On dev it fires on about 87% of L=3, t=5 steps, the copy phase holds all of the activation mass, and in_first==0 on every active step.

The false positives lean slightly toward digit inputs, but this is weak. With a digit input at L=3, t=5 the precision is 0.76, against 0.88 for letters. Dropping inputs 0 and 1 lowers test F1 to 0.734, so this is not a counterexample class worth adding to the predicate.

The misses are a scattered tail: L=4 holds 4.6% of the mass, L=6 2.9% and L=7 1.8%, mostly at to_go 0 or 1 with inputs l, v or r. Adding the L=4, to_go==0, input l/v/r case drops test F1 to 0.674 (precision 0.61). Adding input l at recall_idx 5 drops it to 0.724. This supports the claim that extending the predicate costs too much precision.
Minor overclaim: recall by step count is only 0.665, and the lowest activation quartile is just 22% covered. The label describes the bulk of the activation mass, not every step where the unit fires.

Scope mismatch with the user request: the user asked for the baseline on the subsampled data in features/copy_transcoder_v2_1of5, but this check ran on features/copy_gru_v1_neuron_baseline_store, the store the task specified. I did not confirm that this store was built from the 1/5 subsample.
